summary: OPPONENT_MODEL_DESIGN.md section 4.7's walk row ('no vpip opportunity for anyone') contradicts section 4.2/Table C ('opponent was dealt in', one per hand by definition) and section 4.5's worked example (vpip n=412=hands dealt).
